sections.heading: Quantico Base Clean Up
sections.markdown:
Let's give back to the base and maintain a clean environment for all. Each month will have a specific area on base to focus.

**Dress code:** Clothing is weather dependent. Please dress for the weather conditions and wear sturdy, close toed shoes or boots, you may become wet and muddy depending on the day.

**Time:** 7:30AM

**Location:** MAIN SIDE REC CENTER, 206 Nicholas Rd, Quantico, VA 22134

Authorized patrons of ALL abilities are welcomed. Please contact SMP staff if reasonable accommodations are necessary.

Transportation is only provided to Single Service Members and geo-bachelors associated with the SMP. Seating limited; first come, first served.

For more information, call 703.432.0363 or email: MCCSQUANTICOSMP@USMC-MCCS.ORG

**[Register on Eventbrite](https://www.eventbrite.com/o/mccs-quantico-single-marine-program-smp-12631456557)**
